imageRequests.brief: Prototype Reactor: squat heavy experimental containment frame, four thick angled supports around a cyan luminous vertical chamber, weathered yellow shielding and dirty white maintenance panels. Broad grounded base.

Alien Pod: asymmetric rounded nonhuman machinery, split dark metal shell wrapped around a glowing cyan inner capsule, three sturdy curved feet attached to a common base, one large rusted yellow salvager clamp. Distinct organic mechanical silhouette.

Singularity Engine: two massive angular dark steel containment arches enclosing a luminous cyan spherical core held by thick connected struts, rusted yellow clamps, dirty white access panels. Broad grounded rectangular skids. Iconic bold silhouette.

Vehicle Compactor: heavy four-column hydraulic scrapyard press, large upper yellow hydraulic crown connected by cylinders to lowered platen above a crushed unbranded car shell, dark steel reinforced base, side motor and attached thick pipes. Complete compact machine on a floor base.
